name: Mililani
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Mililani, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Mililani, Hawaii for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Mililani keeps Christmas with local parades, Santa visits and community events.
celebrates: Mililani packs its Christmas into one weekend. Town Center of Mililani's page lists the Holiday Parade on Saturday, December 5, starting at 9 am at Mililani High School Kauinana Stadium and ending at the Town Center, followed by an After Party in Center Court with crafts, face painting and Santa selfies. The next morning the mall serves Breakfast or Lunch with Santa for $5 per person. Neighboring Wahiawa holds its Town Santa Parade the evening before, and the Mililani library has a free Santa story time on November 30.
lastyear: We did not find a 2025 recap on the host pages. Town Center of Mililani's 2026 parade page gives the parade route, which runs along Kipapa Drive past Mililani Shopping Center, then Moenamanu Street, Kuahelani Avenue and Meheula Parkway, and the Wahiawa Community and Business Association's page calls its Santa parade an annual tradition that has run for generations.
facts: Mililani Public Library opened on October 27, 1984, on land donated by Mililani Town, Inc., and is known for murals by artist Hon-Chew Hee, including The Poi Bowl, carved in green Taiwanese marble. Town Center of Mililani sells Breakfast or Lunch with Santa tickets in advance only, with no walk-in sales. The mall lists its phone number as 808-625-0108.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Mililani. Pearlridge Center in Aiea runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Mauka Center Court from November 21, 2026, to January 10, 2027, at $6 per child for children under 48 inches tall. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs a Holiday Express Train Ride, a 90-minute nonstop evening ride decorated with hundreds of lights where riders can wear holiday pajamas, according to our museum page on the society.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, with a Holiday Express Train Ride on restored track.
traditions: A morning parade from Mililani High School to Town Center of Mililani.
Crafts, face painting and Santa selfies in Center Court.
A $5 bento meal with Santa, advance tickets only.
An evening parade of schools, bands and floats presented by the Wahiawa Community and Business Association.
kidfact: Mililani's library has a mural carved from green Taiwanese marble called The Poi Bowl.
faq: With the Mililani Holiday Parade and After Party on December 5 and Breakfast or Lunch with Santa at Town Center of Mililani on December 6.
When is the Mililani Holiday Parade in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, starting at 9 am from Mililani High School Kauinana Stadium.
Is there a free Christmas event in Mililani?
Yes, the parade, the After Party and the library's Santa Claus Story Time on November 30 are listed free or free to watch.
How much is Breakfast or Lunch with Santa?
$5 per person on Sunday, December 6, with advance tickets only.
Is there a Wahiawa Christmas parade?
Yes, the Wahiawa Town Santa Parade is Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 pm.

folded.why: Wahiawa Town Santa Parade built (cand 65363). Whitmore Christmas Village (Dec 19) is on Facebook and Instagram only, so it is held. Dole Plantation lists no holiday event on its homepage.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mililani for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (Santa Claus Story Time at Mililani Public Library) through December 6 (Breakfast or Lunch with Santa at Town Center of Mililani), with the Wahiawa Town Santa Parade (December 4) and the Mililani Holiday Parade and After Party (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Mililani

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Mililani
  • 3 free events: the Mililani Holiday Parade and After Party, the Wahiawa Town Santa Parade and the library story time
  • Meet Santa: Santa Claus Story Time (November 30), Santa selfies at the After Party (December 5) and Breakfast or Lunch with Santa (December 6, $5)
  • Parades: Wahiawa Town Santa Parade (December 4) and Mililani Holiday Parade (December 5)
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest is the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Aiea
  • Season: November 30 to December 6

Planning a bigger day out? Mililani families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Honolulu, which covers Honolulu City Lights, Kapolei City Lights, the Grinch musical at Diamond Head Theatre, 'Twas the Light Before Christmas on Ice and The Nutcracker.
